_note: HISTORICAL ARTEFACT. This file was written by the two-way (train/val) revision of pipeline.py that produced the shipped corpus, which is why it has train_bytes and val_bytes but no test_bytes: val.txt was split into val/test afterwards by common/preprocessing/make_splits.py, and MinHash dedup then ran on each split independently.
